text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: mean score of every row in the 72 hours after the logged end, forecasts issued after the transfer began. Line: 95% interval from resampling the 7 logged transfers. Winter dominates the rows. Six Primary substations, July 2025 to June 2026.'
